title: Engineering tolerogenic mRNA-LNPs for allergen-specific immune reprogramming in pollen allergy.
snippet: Pollen allergy is a prevalent respiratory allergic disease, yet current allergen immunotherapy (AIT) remains limited by safety concerns and insufficient induction of durable immune tolerance.
